notes: The prompt's own words are 'sandbox' with a heavy emphasis on jet skis and sports cars, and both route to Simulation; there is no lap or finish line anywhere in it, which is the stated line between Vehicle Sim and Racing, so this is free-roam operation of vehicles in one shared persistent world — world-open. I kept the Vehicle Sim preset and its hauling routes for the drivable district but dropped resource-shared, since the author explicitly ruled out crime mechanics and there is no extraction loop for a shared field to feed. Water is a first-class request rather than a backdrop — the author confirmed jet skis actually drive on it — so it is emitted as water-body bent to a neon bay off the waterfront, and settlement-density carries the few dense neon-lit blocks the district is made of. Its CHECK is benign: jet skis ride the surface, so the play volume does not self-occlude. I decided without asking that the satirical gritty crime framing is tone applied to the existing buildings rather than any banks, police stations, or chop shops, because the author said exactly that.
